svg.text: Card scanner / sleever / sorter - motion controller wiring
ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (host link: native USB to the Raspberry Pi 5) | 4x TMC2209 (UART addr 0-3) | 2x MCP23017 | 9x logic MOSFET | DRV8833 + N20 | 3x MG90S | pins = firmware/include/config.h
1. One star ground at the PSU -V. Separate returns from: TMC power GND, 12 V buck minus (MOSFET sources), servo buck minus, Pi buck minus. Logic GND joins with one wire.
2. Load currents never return through the ESP32, the USB cable or sensor wiring. MOSFET board gets one thin logic-GND wire for the gate reference.
3. Every sensor module runs from 3V3 (outputs stay below 3.3 V). The vacuum sensor needs 5 V: the 10k/20k divider scales 4.5 V to 3.0 V.
4. Endstops and the lid are normally closed to GND: a cut wire reads as 'at the switch' / 'lid open', which fails safe.
5. GPIO8 EN has a 10k pull-up and every MOSFET gate a 10k pull-down: during reset or flashing, drivers are off and valves closed. DRV8833 inputs have internal pull-downs: the N20 coasts.
7. Air: one pump tees to the hopper puff and the sleeve-mouth jet. Each branch has its own NC valve downstream of the pump: Q6 stack_puff, Q7 mouth_jet.
